in_sanskrit.name: अनग्हा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Absence of blemishes, free from imperfections, spotless, stainless, pure

in_marathi.name: Anagha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Pure, Free from Impurities
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anagha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anagha is a Sanskrit name, derived from the word 'anagha', meaning pure, free from impurities. In Hindu mythology, Anagha is the epithet of Goddess Parvati, signifying her purity and grace. It is also the name of various Hindu goddesses and saints, symbolizing their spiritual purity and enlightenment.
